paragraph: Gilbert Kirk's silver maple had come straight through his roof after a storm. A Kansas man with debris piled on his lawn, he told a local news crew he did not want a miracle. He did not want an insurance handout. He wanted only a tarp. Two days later a stranger stood on that same lawn in Wyandotte County. The man said he had seen the televised plea. He had come to help.
